expectedBehavior: After an authorized Sprint or Epic close, the relevant Markdown projections and indexes should be regenerated or updated deterministically from canonical state.
notes: Acceptance Criteria: 1. Sprint close refreshes Sprint-active.md, Sprint-Documentation.md, and generated Sprint projections. 2. Epic close refreshes Epic-active.md, Epic-Documentation.md, and generated Epic projections. 3. Counts and current/next IDs remain correct after close. 4. Regression coverage proves the indexes are synchronized after close.
Resolution: AgileCockpit close actions now refresh Sprint and Epic Markdown projections and generated records from canonical state.
observedBehavior: AgileCockpit Sprint and Epic close actions update canonical JSON state, but human-facing Markdown indexes and projections can remain stale after close.
reproductionSteps: Close an eligible Sprint or Epic through AgileCockpit.
Inspect the relevant Sprint or Epic Markdown indexes.
Observe stale current, active, closed, count, or generated projection data.

workItem.title: Close actions do not refresh Sprint and Epic indexes
